strongest_angle: Investigation into the October 2026 theft of a newly installed plaque at Portchester Castle commemorating 2,500 Caribbean prisoners brought to Britain 230 years ago in 1796.

key_facts.fact: A memorial plaque commemorating 2,500 African Caribbean prisoners of war was unveiled at Portchester Castle in Hampshire on October 9, 2026.
Castle staff at Portchester Castle discovered that the plaque and a gate padlock had been removed five days later on October 14, 2026.
The stolen memorial marked 230 years since 2,500 African Caribbean men, women and children were brought to Britain as prisoners of war in 1796.
